A Stanford-affiliated founder is someone who is or was one of the following and holds a meaningful equity stake in the company:​ Degree-seeking student (undergraduate, master’s, MBA, PhD).​ Stanford alumnus/alumna who completed at least three academic quarters.​ Stanford faculty member (including assistant and clinical assistant professors).​ Postdoctoral scholar.​ Academic staff or research scientist with a qualifying Stanford appointment.​ Fellow in a recognized Stanford fellowship or scholars program (for example, Knight-Hennessy, Biodesign, DCI, Sloan, or similar programs that confer campus privileges).​ StartX may consider exceptions on a case-by-case basis when applicants receive strong recommendations from multiple members of the StartX community.​ Eligibility & Who Can Apply What does not count as a Stanford affiliation for eligibility?
